h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Unnao

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Unnao

items.pText: On a small school ground in Unnao, the temptation is to fit in one more swing. The space around each piece matters as much as the piece itself, because a child who walks into the path of a moving swing can be badly hurt. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Unnao at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,110 km away, and marks that space on every layout drawing.

Unnao lies between Kanpur and Lucknow in central Uttar Pradesh, with leather and industrial units along the highway and many schools in the town and district. Summers are very hot, winters are cold and foggy, and the monsoon runs from late June to September. The equipment travels by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in north India. Share the length and width of your ground, and we will show how many pieces fit safely.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning safe zones around moving equipment

c: Every piece on our layout drawing has a safe play area around it, and these zones should not overlap with each other or with paths. Swings need the most room, in front and behind, because the seat travels well beyond the frame. A
needs a clear ring all around it, and slides need space at the exit.

Put swings at a corner or edge of the ground, away from the main route children take. Keep benches, trees and water taps out of the safe zones. If the ground is too small for everything you want, drop a piece rather than squeeze the zones. A compact
puts several activities inside one safe zone. See also our

items.q: What is a safe play area?
items.a: It is the clear space around a piece of equipment that children may move or fall into. We mark it on the layout drawing, and nothing else, such as a bench or another piece, should sit inside it.

items.q: How much space does a swing need?
items.a: More than its frame, since the seats travel in front and behind. The exact safe play area depends on the model, and we mark it on the layout drawing.
Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road, about 1,110 km, and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.
